summary:
Main
After the previous broad gains, prices pulled back modestly, highlighting the fragility of the recovery. DCE most-traded closed at 681.5 yuan/mt,down 0.15%. The 61%, 58% and 65% port indices were 660, 616 and 819 yuan/wmt, each down 1 yuan.
